composites.name: biofilm_controlled
composites.description:
Couples a BoundaryControllerProcess to the standard BiofilmProcess: the
controller drives the oxygen boundary concentration on a fixed day
schedule (drop at t=1d, restore at t=3d) through a shared
boundary_concentrations store, demonstrating runtime environmental control
via the Rust set_bulk_by_name hook (Task 6) without touching biofilm
internals -- composability of viva-biofilm processes with process-bigraph.

composites.name: chemostat
composites.description:
Well-mixed chemostat (ODE reactor; reference model: Cockx et al. 2024);
matches protocols/chemostat.xml: solute1 decays at 0.1/day into solute2.

composites.name: biofilm
composites.description:
2D single-species biofilm (reference model: Cockx et al. 2024):
coccoid bacterium on solute+oxygen, reaction-diffusion PDE + agent relaxation
+ division + detachment.
